messages:
maria (eng-platform): Heads up, dashboards are lighting up — large number of requests are being routed US->eu-west for standard tier since ~08:02 UTC. Many are landing on ott-quant-small and causing high tail latency. Not expected.

Dave (eng-sre): Yep, seeing p99 token latency climb and a small bump in 5xx retry rate. Correlates with redispatch counts.

sana (eng-runtime): Is this the prefetch v3 rollout? I pushed that last night to prod-standard.

maria (eng-platform): I think so. Prefetch appears to be pre-warming variants that aren't present locally which then trigger a cross-region redispatch.

jia (eng-ml): Quick theory — prefetch writes KV entries with preferred_variant that don't exist in some regions. When runtime tries local lookup -> miss -> redispatch to other region -> other side doesn't find expected variant and re-redispatches. Can loop if redispatch rules don't cap hops.

Dave (eng-sre): Adding the log snippet I'm seeing:
```
[2059-06-17T08:02:14Z] req=abc123 route=standard-prefer-ott variant=ott-quant-small region=us-west served=false redispatch_count=1 next_region=eu-west
[2059-06-17T08:02:14Z] req=abc123 route=standard-prefer-ott variant=ott-quant-small region=eu-west served=false redispatch_count=2 next_region=us-west
```
Looks like requests are ping-ponging once redispatch_count increments.

opsbot: ALERT: routing-redispatch-rate for service:platform > 300/s (project:redwood-core).

maria (eng-platform): Two immediate mitigations: 1) disable prefetch for standard tier in US regions, 2) short-circuit redispatch hops to max_hops=1 while we investigate. Thoughts? @sana @dave

sana (eng-runtime): I can hotpatch to reduce prefetch_multiplier for 'standard' to 0.0 for US canary hosts and roll if green. Will open a rollback-safe patch.

jia (eng-ml): Also recommend model-variant resolution become region-aware: before redispatching, check target region's variant catalog; if variant missing, try compatible variant or fallback to cpu-safe stub instead of redispatch. Long-term, add variant-availability cache per-region.

maria (eng-platform): Agreed on region-aware lookup. For now, short-term config changes are fine. Can we also emit a metric for redispatch.hop_count per-request and a histogram? That will help threshold alerts.

Dave (eng-sre): I'll add a Grafana panel: redispatch.rate, redispatch.hop_count.hist, per-route. Also add alert when 5xx+redispatch_rate > 50/s for any region.

sana (eng-runtime): deploy-bot: starting hotpatch: set prefetch.v3.capacity_multiplier.standard=0.0 on 3 canary hosts. Canary window 2m.

deploy-bot: deploy started by sana (eng-runtime) — hotpatch id=hp-2059-06-17-01

sana (eng-runtime): Canary metrics look good — redispatch rate down ~85% on those hosts. Rolling to remaining US standard nodes in 3 batches.

maria (eng-platform): Great. Dave, keep tracing sample request ids and confirm no 2-hop cycles. Jia, can you draft a small design note for region-aware variant resolution? We'll schedule follow-up.

jia (eng-ml): On it — will post a short RFC with options (variant cache, compatibility mapping, region precedence) by EOD.

Dave (eng-sre): Cycle check looks clear on canary; after full roll the global redispatch rate dropped to baseline. Setting alert sensitivity lower while we add metrics.

maria (eng-platform): For the postmortem: root cause = prefetch v3 populating preferred_variant keys without region presence check + redispatch policy with no hop cap. Action items: (1) rollback/patch prefetch config (done), (2) add hop cap default=2, (3) region-aware variant lookup, (4) telemetry: redispatch.hop_count histogram + per-route dashboards, (5) e2e test for prefetch+redispatch combos.

opsbot: NOTE: incident auto-ticket created #INC-2059-21 for follow-ups.

maria (eng-platform): Marking stable for now. Will keep monitoring for 30m then write up summary. Thanks all :thumbsup:
